White-border Decipher publisher image of [[Hiding In The Garbage (Revised)]].

== Source ==
* Printed white-border face: [http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/images/hidinginthegarbagewb.gif Hiding In The Garbage], Decipher’s Dagobah card list. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20020616192231id_/http://decipher.com:80/starwars/cardlists/dagobah/light/images/hidinginthegarbagewb.gif Internet Archive], captured 16 June 2002.

The native 367 × 506-pixel GIF is reproduced byte for byte, including its full card edges and publisher drop shadow. No crop, recoloring, resampling or text replacement was performed. The capture date is not a card release date.
